condition: A due milestone is past its overdue window
recommended_action: Home visit by the CHW this week; book the next session

condition: A due milestone is past its defaulter window
recommended_action: Defaulter tracing visit; escalate to the supervisor if not found in two attempts

condition: Zero-dose child registered more than 4 weeks ago still has no Penta 1
recommended_action: Priority visit and escort to the next session

condition: No submissions from a CHW within the inactivity window
recommended_action: Call the CHW; check phone, airtime and network

condition: Vaccine stock under the low-stock days threshold
recommended_action: Request resupply from the LGA cold store

condition: Facility reports days out of stock
Fridge not working or temperature alarms reported
recommended_action: Move vaccines to the nearest working fridge; request repair
Review session sizes and open-vial practice

condition: Dropout above the maximum for an LGA or facility
recommended_action: Review missed-dose reasons; plan reminder visits

condition: Many missed doses with reason 'vaccine not available' where stock records show stock
recommended_action: Reconcile stock records with the facility; check session scheduling

condition: Two child records match on caregiver phone, date of birth and name
recommended_action: Confirm with the CHW and merge the records

condition: Dose before minimum age, Penta 3 before Penta 1, or doses too close together
recommended_action: Check the card with the CHW and correct the record

condition: Visit uses a child ID not found in the register
recommended_action: Match by name and caregiver with the CHW; correct the ID

condition: Visit GPS further than allowed from the CHW's facility
recommended_action: Confirm where the visit took place

condition: Caregiver phone check does not confirm a recorded dose
recommended_action: Review the CHW's records for the period; refresher supervision
Check the catchment population and look for duplicate children

condition: Children still linked to a CHW whose status is 'left'
recommended_action: Reassign the children to an active CHW at the same facility

condition: CHW or facility above target with low dropout for three months
recommended_action: Use as a peer mentor for low-performing CHWs nearby
